route: C: observation-conditioned warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v93 independently localizes the sole v92 failure, but the preregistered deployment-visible locator fails all three gates
headline_zh: v93 证明最后缺口高度局部且以 z 负侧低频结构为主，但预注册法向残差定位器三门全失败；下一步先改可观测壳，不能直接训练局部预测器。
next_scientific_gate: revise the observable shell before any local representation search; validate a preregistered coarse locator on local maps not used to select it or explicitly budget one minimal additional exact operator action
next_scientific_gate_zh: 先修改可观测壳：把 detector anchor 的粗位置线索另行冻结，并在未参与选择的局部误差图上验证；若仍看不见，再明确增加最小精确调用预算。此门通过前不训练局部预测器。
